commits.message:
Add new skills and workflows for resource management and testing

- Create e2e-test-runner skill for end-to-end testing procedures.
- Add example-generator skill to generate Terraform example configurations.
- Implement issue-to-resource-spec skill for parsing resource requests from GitHub issues.
- Introduce naming-rules-drift-check skill to verify Azure naming rules against current definitions.
- Develop pr-compliance-check skill to validate pull request compliance with project standards.
- Establish pre-release-validation skill for comprehensive checks before release tagging.
- Create readme-resource-table skill to update resource status in README.md.
- Add regression-test-runner skill for running full CI test suite and reporting results.
- Implement release-notes-generator skill for generating release notes from CHANGELOG.md.
- Create resource-bulk-import skill for batch importing Azure resources into resourceDefinition.json.
- Develop resource-completeness-check skill to compare resource definitions against existing resources.
- Introduce resource-diff-report skill for comparing different versions of resourceDefinition.json.
- Add semver-assessment skill to analyze changes and determine semantic version bumps.
- Implement test-failure-diagnosis skill for diagnosing test failures and suggesting fixes.
- Create workflows for contributor welcome, issue-to-PR automation, nightly regression testing, PR review, release validation, and weekly Azure sync.

md_changes.file_patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,82 @@
+---
+description: |
+  PR review agent that validates pull request compliance. Checks that
+  resourceDefinition.json changes include regenerated models, CHANGELOG
+  is updated, and tests pass. Runs on PR open and update.
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    types: [opened, synchronize]
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+  pull-requests: read
+
+network: defaults
+
+tools:
+  github:
+    lockdown: true
+    toolsets: [pull_requests]
+  bash:
+    - "git *"
+    - "go *"
+    - "make *"
+    - "grep *"
+    - "diff *"
+    - "cat *"
+    - "wc *"
+
+safe-outputs:
+  add-comment: {}
+
+source: local
+engine: copilot
+---
+
+# PR Review Agent
+
+Review the pull request for compliance with project conventions.
+
+## Checks
+
+### 1. Generated code freshness
+If `resourceDefinition.json` is modified in this PR:
+- Run `go generate` and check if `azurecaf/models_generated.go` has uncommitted changes
+- If stale, comment with: "Generated code is stale. Please run `go generate` and commit the result."
+
+### 2. CHANGELOG updated
+If any `.go` or `.json` file is modified:
+- Check that `CHANGELOG.md` is also in the diff
+- If missing, comment with: "Please update CHANGELOG.md with a description of your changes."
+
+### 3. Resource diff summary
+If `resourceDefinition.json` is modified:
+- Compare the PR version against main
+- Count added, removed, and modified resources
+- Comment with a summary table of changes
+
+### 4. Build verification
+- Run `make build` to verify the PR compiles and tests pass
+- If failures, comment with the error output
+
+## Comment format
+
+Post a single review comment combining all results:
+
+```markdown
+### 🤖 PR Compliance Review
+
+| Check | Status |
+|-------|--------|
+| Generated code fresh | ✅ / ❌ |
+| CHANGELOG updated | ✅ / ❌ |
+| Build passes | ✅ / ❌ |
+
+<details if resource changes>
+#### Resource Changes
+| Resource | Change | Details |
+|----------|--------|---------|
+| ... | Added/Modified/Removed | ... |
+</details>
+```

commits.message:
ci: align Go toolchain across env + SHA-pin hand-authored workflows

- devcontainer: bump Go feature 1.24.4 -> 1.25.0 to match go.mod (build would have failed in the dev container otherwise)
- CONTRIBUTING: update prerequisite to Go 1.25.0+
- workflows (hand-authored: codeql, copilot-setup-steps, e2e, go, security): SHA-pin actions/checkout@v6.0.2 (de0fac2e) and actions/setup-go@v6.4.0 (4a3601121d), matching the SHA-pinning posture of the gh-aw-managed agentic lock files. Mitigates CWE-829 tag-mutability risk.
- pr-review-agent: add pre-agent 'Set up Go' + 'Build provider' steps so the agent can verify 'make build' against go.mod 1.25.0. Previously reported 'Build passes Unverified -- Go toolchain unavailable in sandbox' because the gh-aw firewall agent container has no Go. Build now runs on host runner; agent reads BUILD_RESULT from /tmp/pr-review-results.env. Recompiled lock file with gh-aw v0.72.1.
- actions-lock.json: auto-updated by gh-aw to include actions/setup-go@v6.
- CHANGELOG: document all of the above.

+steps:
+  - name: Set up Go
+    uses: actions/setup-go@v6
+    with:
+      go-version-file: './go.mod'
+      cache: true
+
+  - name: Build provider
+    id: build
+    continue-on-error: true
+    run: |
+      set -o pipefail

+        echo "BUILD_RESULT=pass" > /tmp/pr-review-results.env

+        echo "BUILD_RESULT=fail" > /tmp/pr-review-results.env
+      fi
+      # Keep a short tail for the agent prompt
+      tail -n 80 /tmp/pr-build.log > /tmp/pr-build-tail.log || true
+

commits.message:
fix(workflow): move pr-review-agent build artifacts from /tmp to workspace

The PR Review Agent's pre-agent step writes build results to /tmp/, which
is blocked by the agent sandbox security policy. The agent cannot read
/tmp/pr-review-results.env or /tmp/pr-build-tail.log, causing it to fail
with 'missing tools' errors.

Move all build artifacts to .pr-review/ in the workspace directory, which
is accessible from both the pre-agent step and the agent sandbox.

Fixes #460

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
